cover.prompt: Under the Doric portico of House 3 on the Arche ring road, arche-accountant in brown himation sits on a stone bench beside a low marble table, writing rapid entries on an open wax diptych with bronze stylus held clear of his chest; arche-clerk stands in an energetic 3/4 pose holding an unrolled papyrus ledger wide with both hands, elbows out 20 degrees, dictating with head turned in profile; a fluted Doric column frames the left margin as a foreground anchor; the diagonal facade of the trading house recedes at 40 degrees, revealing the sunny ring road and harbour slipways descending to the sparkling sea under a cloudless sky.
cover.others: arche-messenger running along the road in the midground.
